Important source-reported settings extracted; not a complete operating procedure. F1, F2, substrate temperature and Ar growth pressure are jointly varied. Figure 3 values P=71.4 mTorr/T=526 degC/F1=1.20/F2=1.44 J cm^-2 are a surrogate-model predicted optimum, not an observed recipe-property measurement, and are intentionally not loaded as such. Optical contrast stopping criterion -0.364 is model-derived nominal monolayer thickness, not proof of uniform monolayer output. No laser power from the remote 140 W heater is treated as delivered target power.

relationship_candidates.fixed_conditions_text: Same aqueous zinc nitrate precursor, air 1.5 SLPM, ultrasonic nebulizer 2.1 MHz, furnace 500 degC, 2 h synthesis and 30-32 s mist residence; otherwise same described USP setup.
relationship_candidates.source_title: Structural and Morphological Properties of Nanostructured ZnO Particles Grown by Ultrasonic Spray Pyrolysis Method with Horizontal Furnace
relationship_candidates.caveats: Only two measured concentrations; no validated linear concentration-size law, and substantial size dispersion. Secondary particles are aggregates of smaller crystallites. No extrapolation.
